description: In front of you are two toy bread slices, a small green plate, and several felt sandwich fillings like a pink round slice, a green lettuce leaf, a red tomato slice, onion rings, and bacon strips. The right hand brings a bread slice onto the green plate while the left hand picks up the pink slice and lays it on the bread; then the left hand places the lettuce on top, the right hand adds the tomato and onion rings, and finally the right hand sets the bacon strips on top to build the sandwich stack.
